_comment: Widened source list. 51 search queries + 5 YouTube channels.
Windows are sized by MEASURED volume, not guesswork:
thaveka at when:1d returned 100 = still at Google's cap -> 6h
Velachery at when:2d returned 3 = genuinely low volume -> 1d/2d/7d by topic
One query costs a network call; one keyword costs 0.01 ms. So places are
OR-grouped into shared queries rather than given a query each.
Re-run 'python collect.py --init' after editing. Existing rows are untouched.
blocked_hosts: skipped before their Google token is decoded, never extracted.
dailyhunt.in added -- 7 items resolved there at ~500 chars, aggregator stubs.
GDELT entries use kind 'rss' with a full url -- collect.py's feed_url_for()
only builds urls for google_news and youtube; everything else needs 'url'.
GDELT is a SEPARATE index from Google News and is not subject to the 100 cap;
yt_thanthi is DISABLED: its channel id returned 0 entries on 20 Sep.
Run verify.py, pick a channel whose uploads are news, then re-enable.

v2 (20 Sep lab run): never use bare 'IT' in a query -- Google is case-insensitive and it matches the word 'it'. Mention queries widened to 7d: one minister's name is low-volume. vel_flood stays at 1d; zero in dry weather is correct.

v3: GDELT disabled (zero at 7d). gn_en_mla disabled (covered by gn_en_name). Three slow queries at 14d/30min. political + opportunity keep near-zero on keywords by design -- they are AI-judged categories.
